title: Vanya and Treasure
statementMd:
Vanya is in the palace that can be represented as a grid $*n* × *m*$. Each room contains a single chest, an the room located in the $*i*$-th row and $*j*$-th columns contains the chest of type $*a*_{*ij*}$. Each chest of type $*x* ≤ *p* - 1$ contains a key that can open any chest of type $*x* + 1$, and all chests of type $1$ are not locked. There is exactly one chest of type $*p*$ and it contains a treasure.

Vanya starts in cell $(1, 1)$ (top left corner). What is the minimum total distance Vanya has to walk in order to get the treasure? Consider the distance between cell $(*r*_{1}, *c*_{1})$ (the cell in the row $*r*_{1}$ and column $*c*_{1}$) and $(*r*_{2}, *c*_{2})$ is equal to $|*r*_{1} - *r*_{2}| + |*c*_{1} - *c*_{2}|$.

## Input

The first line of the input contains three integers $*n*$, $*m*$ and $*p*$ ($1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 300, 1 ≤ *p* ≤ *n*·*m*$) — the number of rows and columns in the table representing the palace and the number of different types of the chests, respectively.

Each of the following $*n*$ lines contains $*m*$ integers $*a*_{*ij*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*ij*} ≤ *p*$) — the types of the chests in corresponding rooms. It's guaranteed that for each $*x*$ from $1$ to $*p*$ there is at least one chest of this type (that is, there exists a pair of $*r*$ and $*c*$, such that $*a*_{*rc*} = *x*$). Also, it's guaranteed that there is exactly one chest of type $*p*$.

## Output

Print one integer — the minimum possible total distance Vanya has to walk in order to get the treasure from the chest of type $*p*$.
statementZhMd:
瓦尼亚身处一座可以表示为 $*n* × *m*$ 网格的宫殿中。每个房间里都有一个箱子，位于第 $*i*$ 行第 $*j*$ 列的房间中放置着类型为 $*a*_{*ij*}$ 的箱子。每个类型为 $*x* ≤ *p* - 1$ 的箱子中都有一把钥匙，可以打开任意一个类型为 $*x* + 1$ 的箱子；所有类型为 $1$ 的箱子都没有上锁。恰好有一个类型为 $*p*$ 的箱子，其中装有宝藏。

瓦尼亚从单元格 $(1, 1)$（左上角）出发。他至少需要行走多远才能拿到宝藏？定义单元格 $(*r*_{1}, *c*_{1})$（第 $*r*_{1}$ 行、第 $*c*_{1}$ 列）与单元格 $(*r*_{2}, *c*_{2})$ 之间的距离为 $|*r*_{1} - *r*_{2}| + |*c*_{1} - *c*_{2}|$。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含三个整数 $*n*$、$*m*$ 和 $*p*$（$1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 300, 1 ≤ *p* ≤ *n*·*m*$）——表示宫殿的行数和列数，以及箱子的不同类型数。

接下来的 $*n*$ 行中，每行包含 $*m*$ 个整数 $*a*_{*ij}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*ij*} ≤ *p*$）——对应房间中箱子的类型。保证对于每个 $*x*$（从 $1$ 到 $*p*$），至少存在一个该类型的箱子（即存在一对 $*r*$ 和 $*c*$，使得 $*a*_{*rc*} = *x*$）。此外，保证恰好存在一个类型为 $*p*$ 的箱子。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数——瓦尼亚从类型为 $*p*$ 的箱子中取得宝藏所需行走的最小总距离。
